name: crysta
tagline: A crystal workbench in the browser: view, measure, export
description: Browser tool for crystal structures: 3D view, bonding and frameworks, measurements, simulated powder XRD patterns compared with measured data, PNG, SVG and mol2 export, with 2D perovskite layer descriptors, transition-dipole axes and multi-structure comparison

citation.title: Crysta: a crystal structure workbench in the browser
